source.author: verg
source.text: Dixit, et extemplo, neque enim responsa dabantur fida satis, sensit medios delapsus in hostis.
source.text_original: Dixit, et extemplo, neque enim responsa dabantur / fida satis, sensit medios delapsus in hostis.
source.text_english: He spoke, and at once—for no reliable answers were being given enough—he realized that he had fallen into the midst of enemies.
